scope: Public descriptions of AI demand, agentic Internet and orbital computing, not private beliefs, demonstrated future outcomes, or a technology endorsement.

sources.publisher: Elon Musk Archive (independent archived transcript linked to video)
sources.date_note: Session is dated 2026-11-06; transcript page publication time is not separately verified
sources.scope: Attests publicly attributed speech, not engineering performance or inner beliefs

sources.publisher: Cloudflare Q2 2026 earnings call via Quartr/StockAnalysis
sources.scope: CEO retrospective report and forecast, not a transparent full-network universal census

sources.date_note: 2026 session, calendar publication day not established; do not backdate to a specific day
sources.scope: First-party CEO speech supports his attributed claims, not independent AI classification

sources.date_note: Period 2026-10-01 through 2026-10-12; dynamic results, no frozen request counts
sources.scope: Bot-vs-human metric is HTML-response HTTP requests on Cloudflare-measured traffic; not AI-agent fraction of all global bytes
Company reports a TPU prototype running early model/telemetry output in orbit; not an industrial-scale orbital data center
Independent assessment of engineering/financial barriers as at April 2026

statements.speaker: Elon Musk
statements.locator: Agentic internet traffic passage; speaker Musk
statements.proposition_zh: 引述 Cloudflare，稱 Agent 網路活動似乎已超過人類；認為未來約五年 Agent 流量相較人類可能達千倍，並猜測千倍還是低估。
statements.notes: Musk presents Cloudflare estimate, not Musk-originated 1000x data; exact denominator, byte/request measure and global population unknown.

statements.speaker: Matthew Prince
statements.locator: Q2 2026 earnings call, analyst Q&A non-human traffic
statements.proposition_zh: 稱 Cloudflare 團隊於 2026 年五月觀察到非人類自動化流量超過人類流量，較原先預測提前。
statements.notes: Non-human includes more than AI agents; may include bots and malicious traffic. Scope and measurement method require independent review.

statements.speaker: Matthew Prince
statements.locator: Q2 2026 earnings call, conditional five-year forecast
statements.proposition_zh: 若當時趨勢延續，五年後非人類網路流量可能達人類流量的約千倍。
statements.notes: Original speaker says non-human rather than strictly AI agent. Conditional projection, not a point observation.

statements.speaker: Elon Musk
statements.locator: Starlink V2/V3 comparison and fleet forecast
statements.proposition_zh: 認為 Starlink V3 衛星能力相較 V2 超過十倍，配合衛星數擴張，期望約兩到三年內系統總頻寬達當時約百倍。
statements.notes: More-than-10x per-V3 hardware statement is separate from the 100x system-level future forecast.

statements.speaker: Elon Musk
statements.locator: Starlink V4 satellite and laser links
statements.proposition_zh: 估計 Starlink V4 衛星可能比 V3 再有十倍能力，並談到下一代衛星間雷射連結容量提高。
statements.notes: Do not confuse with AI traffic ratio, V3/V2 ratio, total Starlink bandwidth or real traffic demand.

statements.speaker: Elon Musk
statements.proposition_zh: 猜測約於 2027 年第三季開始發射與 NVIDIA 共同設計的軌道運算系統，2028 年較明顯擴張、2029 年可能大規模部署。
statements.notes: Speaker explicitly indicates guess; not a dated commitment or tested large orbital computing service.

statements.speaker: Elon Musk
statements.locator: Digital superintelligence demand and orbital energy passage
statements.proposition_zh: 認為未來巨量數位智慧的主要需求部分可能來自其他數位智慧，並視太空能源及軌道運算為實現極大算力擴張的途徑。
statements.notes: Agent-to-agent traffic is not proven final human purchasing power; orbital compute ability is not evidence of self-sustaining economic revenue.

counter_evidence.observation_zh: Google 報告軌道 TPU 原型已完成初期模型回應與遙測工作；顯示小規模技術展示有進展。
GAO 指出大型軌道資料中心散熱、供電、通訊、成本與太空碰撞風險尚有重大工程障礙。
Cloudflare Radar 的 bot/human 比較針對特定期間、回應 HTML 的 HTTP 請求；其數據集合與整個網路流量總位元組不同。

research_hypotheses.question_zh: 未來某些網路請求、代理流程或機器對機器互動能否在特定可定義母體中占多數？
observation_requirements: separate bot, AI agent, non-AI automation and human proxies
request count versus bytes versus final task outcomes
rival_explanations: many requests generated by a few crawlers
browser or security automation classified as non-human
human-facing tasks still dominate economic demand

research_hypotheses.question_zh: 衛星算力是否在特定任務與總成本契約下優於地面資料中心？
observation_requirements: heat rejection, radiation tolerance and maintenance
inter-satellite optical link and return bandwidth
energy balance including ground and orbit
rival_explanations: terrestrial energy/grid improvements beat launch savings
satellite constraints favor edge processing only

research_hypotheses.question_zh: AI 產生的 AI 網路工作量，能否形成實際具可持續收益來源的終端需求？
rival_explanations: internal loop traffic not paid final demand
unbounded polling without marginal social benefit
agent demand economically financed by humans and institutions
models optimizing requests instead of results
